visual_identity.core_identity: A stationary cave predator resembling a stalagmite, revealed by one central eye, a toothed mouth, and multiple long adhesive tendrils.
visual_identity.silhouette: Tall tapering cone like a stalagmite, rooted broad base, and several long rope-like tendrils radiating outward.
visual_identity.head_features: No separate head; a single eye and horizontal toothed mouth are embedded in the upper stone-like body.
visual_identity.body_shape: Conical flexible central trunk with several long simple tendrils emerging from its sides.
visual_identity.surface: Rocklike folds and ridges kept sparse enough to preserve the camouflage silhouette.

accuracy_checks: could plausibly resemble a stalagmite at rest
